isolate.narration: Filter ${var.field} for the value that stood out in its Top values. Click the + next to it, or use Add filter.

demonstration.narration: I'll filter ${var.field} to the value that stood out, so only its requests remain to inspect.
demonstration.reasoning: The window mixes that traffic with healthy requests elsewhere. A filter pill on the observed value narrows the view to just those requests, and its × widens it again.
demonstration.evidence: The ${var.field}: ${param.incident.finding} pill keeps only those records, and the hit count shows how many requests remain. Opening one will show whether they are the failing ones.

hints: Filter on the value that stood out in the Top values, not one you assumed.
Click the + next to it in the field's Top values, or use Add filter (field, operator ‘is’, value).
Filter ${var.field} for ${param.incident.finding}; Show me can add the reference filter.

drifts.note: You filtered on ${action.field}: ${action.value}; check whether that value is really where the failures concentrate.

demonstration.narration: I'll open one failed request to check its endpoint or service and its error details together.
demonstration.reasoning: A total can look convincing even when it includes an unrelated record. Opening a typical event checks the key values together, rather than relying on a count alone.
demonstration.evidence: This one failed request carries ${param.incident.finding}, status ${param.incident.status} and ${param.incident.error_type} together, so the filtered count isn't mixing unrelated failures. ${truth.conclusion}

goal.title: Look at where the requests concentrate
goal.concept: A field's Top values count every request in the window, so they show where traffic concentrates before you have to guess.
goal.narration: The report doesn't say which endpoint or service is failing. Open the ${var.field} field in the sidebar and read its Top values to see which value most of the window's requests share.
goal.reasoning: Filtering on a guessed endpoint would assume the answer. The Top values show where the window's traffic actually concentrates.
goal.evidence: The field's Top values show one value carrying far more of the window than any other.

demonstration.narration: The report doesn't say which endpoint or service is failing. I'll check ${var.field} Top values to see where this window's requests concentrate.
demonstration.reasoning: Filtering on a guessed endpoint would assume the answer. Top values count every request in the window, so the next filter comes from the data.
demonstration.evidence: The highlighted row, ${param.incident.finding}, carries most of the window's requests, well ahead of every other ${var.field} value. Traffic that concentrated is where to look for the post-release errors, so it's the value to filter on.
